Initial release of strava-activities skill.

- Integrates Strava with OpenClaw via ClawLink for easy activity tracking and athlete data access.
- Allows users to list activities, inspect stats, explore routes/segments, and manage club activity, all without direct Strava API setup.
- Guides setup through ClawLink plugin installation, pairing, and Strava connection using secure flows.
- dynamically fetches and uses ClawLink-provided Strava tools, respecting permissions and confirming before changes.
- Clear guidance and safeguards for handling credentials and critical actions.
